exposure: anogenital warts at the time of delivery
all deliveries during the same period
sexually transmitted infections (HIV, hepatitis B, syphilis)
outcome: sexually transmitted infections (HIV, hepatitis B, syphilis)
cohort: This study included 490 pregnant women with anogenital warts at the time of delivery out of 90,262 deliveries.
finding: Pregnant women with anogenital warts at the time of delivery had a higher prevalence of low birth weight, very low birth weight, overt diabetes mellitus, sexually transmitted infections (HIV, hepatitis B, syphilis), and teenage pregnancy.
